plan_elements.goal_statement: Add a deterministic, test-only safety net that pins the current hardware group lifetime, ordered option/reset, settings projection/persistence, and shutdown coordination behavior required by the Phase-4 and Phase-5 extraction sequence, without creating a new production seam or touching live runtime state.
exit_criteria: The campaign diff outside campaign documentation is limited to the six exclusively owned test files: one new Library characterization file, one new Application projection file, and four existing Application test files; no production, project, package, gate, golden-master, or operational file changes.

AC adds four passing hardware lifetime facts that prove Computer dynamic-group registration/forwarding/detachment/reverse close and rollback/retry, Nvidia partial factory cleanup and lease release, and Storage partial factory cleanup and unsubscribe behavior.

AD adds eight passing facts that prove active same-key option coalescing, reset follow-up ordering, typed failure events with continued drain, cancellation admission, UI-close takeover, BeginInvoke-style shutdown waiting, shared fault completion, and dispatch-failure retry.

AE adds eight passing facts that prove UserOption and UserRadioGroup projection/event ordering and null-name behavior, malformed typed-value fallbacks, duplicate-key last-wins normalization, and managed-path startup fail-closed behavior.

All characterization tests use test-local fakes, in-memory settings, managed-path injection, or unique temporary directories; they do not construct MainForm or access live hardware, Task Scheduler, registry, listener ports, production configuration, or attended test surfaces.

The deterministic solution filter discovers exactly 279 cases with 278 passed and exactly the pre-existing LHM_LIVE_CONFIG_PATH opt-in skip; every new case passes and no baseline case is lost, duplicated, or newly skipped.

The focused Library and Application filters, complete deterministic solution filter, WinForms x64 Release net10.0-windows and net472 builds, full CI gate sweep, plan preflight, and git diff checks all pass.

Exclusive worktree ownership is preserved, each implementation lane returns a committed test-only change, integration is smallest-diff-first, and no unrelated dirty or ignored state is merged or removed.

Read-only SND-HOST proof confirms the live deployment remains separate and healthy while scheduled tasks, settings, logs, release store, rollback store, and the non-Git operations tree remain untouched.

The campaign plan and history contain criterion-specific evidence with ledger state implemented but not automatically accepted; Phase 3 characterization is closed, the backlog advances to Plan-008, and live-tracker records all four lanes.
